chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Musa, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Touch the Corner (of the Black Stone), for it is the Right Hand of Allah among His creatures. He shakes hands with His creatures by it, like the shaking of hands of a servant or a man. The one who touches it testifies to loyalty.'

key_terms.الرُّكْنُ: The Corner (referring to the Black Stone in the Kaaba)
key_terms.يَمِينُ اللَّهِ: The Right Hand of Allah (metaphorical for authority and closeness)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of touching the Black Stone during Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the Black Stone as the 'Right Hand of Allah' (Yamin Allah), a title reflecting its role as a tangible point of contact for divine covenant rather than an object of worship. The Prophet’s description of it as a 'handshake' (muwafah) underscores the believer's personal allegiance to God, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis which views the stone as a witness to the believer's fidelity on the Day of Judgment.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Musa, from Ali Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Touch the corner (of the Black Stone), for it is the Right Hand of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> among His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures. He<sup>azwj</sup> Shakes hands with His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures by it, like the shaking of the hands of the servants, or the man testifies, the one who touches it, with the loyalty’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Ahmad ibn Musa from Ali ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said this.

‘You should touch the corner (of the Black Stone); it is the right hand of Allah among His creatures with which He shakes hands with His creatures, like shaking hands by a slave - or a man (uncertainty is by the narrator) - and those who touch it bear witness to their standing up to their covenant.’”
